messages.author: 205f2582ee7c59c4
messages.subject: overlay images in leaflet?
parts:
Hello,

Wondering if image overlays were ever implemented for leaflet, and if not, when they might be. It is very useful to be able to throw rasters on a map, and many users likely want to do this. Thanks.

-J

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: overlay images in leaflet?
parts:
There's an open PR here: https://github.com/rstudio/leaflet/pull/110

You can try it yourself with devtools::install_github("rstudio/leaflet@joe/feature/raster-image")

This adds an addRasterImage function that takes a RasterLayer (from the raster package) and optionally a color palette or function. Feedback is more than welcome.

messages.author: 205f2582ee7c59c4
messages.subject: Re: overlay images in leaflet?
parts:
Thanks, Joe. I just tested it and I'm getting this error:
Error in sp::CRS("+init=epsg:3785") : no system list, errno: 2

Looks like this isn't the syntax in PROJ4 for that projection, but this seems to be it, from http://spatialreference.org/ref/epsg/popular-visualisation-crs-mercator/:
+proj=merc +lon_0=0 +k=1 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +a=6378137 +b=6378137 +towgs84=0,0,0,0,0,0,0 +units=m +no_defs

Does this work on your end because you explicitly defined this in sp before? Thanks for your help.

-J
